pins.name: LOUT/DFS
pins.connect: left analog audio out (to codec line input through a coupling capacitor); becomes the frame-sync INPUT in digital audio mode

pins.name: GPO3/DCLK
pins.connect: general output; bit-clock INPUT in digital audio mode; second crystal pin in crystal mode

pins.name: GPO2/INTB
pins.connect: interrupt (seek/tune complete, RDS); internal pull-down while RST low; must be 0 at RST rising

pins.name: GPO1
pins.connect: internal pull-up while RST low; must be 1 (left high-Z) at RST rising for 2-wire mode; leave open or test point

pins.name: RFGND
pins.connect: RF ground, to the ground plane at the chip

pins.name: ROUT/DOUT
pins.connect: right analog audio out; digital audio data OUT in digital mode

supplies.VDD: 2.7-3.6 V single supply, -20 to 85 C; operates with degraded specs down to 2.0 V at 25 C (short ds p2)
supplies.current: [D60 SSOP, VA+VD] FM analog out about 19.2 mA typ (21.9 max); AM analog out about 15.4 mA typ; power-down about 12.5 uA typ (25 max) with SCLK/RCLK inactive (D60 p5). No Si4732-specific figure is published.

logic.levels: [D60] VIH 0.7*VD, VIL 0.3*VD, VOH 0.8*VD at 500 uA; on Si4732 the I/O supply is VDD (one pin), so 3.3 V logic: VIH 2.31 V. Not 1.8 V capable in SOIC.
logic.i2c: 2-wire mode, up to 400 kHz (D60 p7); 7-bit address 0x11 (0010001b) with SEN = 0, 0x63 (1100011b) with SEN = 1 (AN332 p124)
logic.bus_select: sampled at RST rising: GPO1 = 1 and GPO2 = 0 -> 2-wire (internal 1 M pull-up/down are active while RST is low, so leave both undriven); GPO1 driven 0 -> 3-wire (D60 p26 table 14)
logic.reset: RST low >= 100 us after all supplies are up when GPO1/GPO2 are high-Z; RST must be low before any supply ramps down and during ramp-up (flash-corruption warning); SCLK must be high at RST rising and stay high until the first START; no START within 300 ns before RST rising (D60 p6 table 3, p27)
logic.clock: RCLK input accepts 31.130 kHz-40 MHz with prescaler 1-4095 so that REFCLK = 31.130-34.406 kHz; tolerance +-100 ppm (+-50 ppm for 50 kHz FM seek and SW) (D60 p15). So a 32.768 kHz square wave from the brain or the RTC chip works; the crystal is optional. Crystal mode uses GPO3/DCLK as the second crystal pin and therefore excludes digital audio (AN332 p15: XOSCEN with OPMODE 00000101 = analog out).
logic.audio: analog out: FM 80 mVrms typ (72-90) [test condition in D60 p11-13], AM 60 mVrms typ (54-67) at 30 % modulation; load >= 10 k, <= 50 pF; single-ended, DC level not specified -> AC couple. Analog and digital audio share pins 1/16: one or the other, chosen in POWER_UP (AN332 p14-15). Digital: slave only (needs DCLK and DFS from the host), I2S/left-justified/DSP, 32/44.1/48 kHz, 8-24 bit (D60 p22). FM figure is at 22.5 kHz deviation (D60 p11-13 note 4): about 0.27 Vrms at full 75 kHz deviation (my arithmetic).

to_brain: SCLK, SDIO on a brain I2C bus that does NOT carry the port expander driving RST (see conflicts)
RCLK: 32.768 kHz from the RTC chip's clock output or a brain timer pin (3.3 V swing), if no crystal is fitted
to_expander: RST (slow, but see the SCLK-high rule)

antenna.FM: headphone lead (1.1-1.45 m) on FMI through 100 pF with 270 nH to ground and 2.5 k beads in every other jack conductor; or a whip with 56 nH (AN383 p18-20, p37-38)
antenna.AM_LW: ferrite loop 180-450 uH direct to AMI through 0.47 uF; air loop 10-20 uH through a 1:5 transformer (D60 p19; AN383 p39-44)
antenna.SW: whip up to 56 cm into AMI through 4.7 uH; no external LNA in Skyworks' circuit (AN383 p45-48)
antenna.sharing: FM and SW can share one whip (AN383 fig 29); sharing with other radios is not described. The 3-pole jack's ground conductor is the FM antenna in Skyworks' circuit, which means beads in the jack ground return too.

notes: It is the -A10: the only Si4732 revision; ordering code Si4732-A10-GS, 'R' suffix = reel (short ds p2).

The public Si4732 data sheet has no electrical tables and no application schematic; AN332 p2 says the A10 carries the same FM and AM/SW/LW firmware as Si4735-D60, so D60 tables and AN383 circuits are used and marked [D60].
AN383's own sections name Si473x QFN/SSOP parts, not the SOIC Si4732; the antenna circuits are pin-function based and carry over.
SDIO activity during seek/tune degrades reception when the internal crystal oscillator is used: use the seek/tune-complete interrupt instead of polling (D60 p25).
Level into the codec: 60-80 mVrms full-scale-ish audio needs roughly +20 dB of input gain at the ES8316 for a 1 Vrms-class ADC input (my arithmetic).
pin_plan_conflicts: Plan row says 'I2C, I2S'; the HF I2S pads (SAI4) are assigned to the PCM1808, so Si4732 digital audio has no pads. Analog LOUT/ROUT to the ES8316 input is consistent with that; in that case pins 1/16 are analog only.

No I2C bus is named for the Si4732 in docs/hack-pad-pins.md. If RST is on a port expander on I2C_P, put the Si4732 on I2C_U or I2C_S: an expander on the same bus changes its output while SCL is low at the acknowledge, which breaks 'SCLK high at RST rising'.
No pad is planned for RCLK: needs a 32.768 kHz source (RTC clock output) or its own crystal.
Reset line is not in the plan (expander line needed); INT optional.
unverified: All electrical numbers are from the Si473x-D60 data sheet, not from a Si4732 document
SENB polarity on the Si4732 SOIC: AN332 p124 gives SEN=0 -> 0x11 generically; hobby reports of the opposite default exist [mem] - firmware should probe both addresses
Supply current of the SOIC part (D60 SSOP figures used)
Crystal: the stocked Epson 12.5 pF part has 70 k ESR against a 50 k limit - prefer the external clock
ES8316 input gain/impedance for 60-80 mVrms not checked here
No JLCPCB-stocked ferrite rod antenna found by keyword search
